sampleSentences.german: Er blieb ruhig, obschon er wütend war.

quiz.prompt: ___ er müde war, arbeitete er weiter. (although)
quiz.fullAnswer: Obschon er müde war, arbeitete er weiter.

goodToKnow: Obschon means although, a literary or old-fashioned synonym of obwohl, with the verb at the end of the clause: Obschon er reich war, lebte er bescheiden. Similar formal options are obgleich and wenngleich. In Switzerland, obschon is still fairly common. In everyday German, use obwohl or, in speech, obwohl with main-clause order is also heard.
